issues.legal_issue: An incident occurring inside a complainant’s office chamber, with colleagues arriving only after the incident, does not occur in a place within public view for purposes of Sections 3(1)(r) and 3(1)(s) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Criminal proceedings may be quashed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure when the allegations, accepted in their entirety, do not prima facie constitute an offence.
